ns2:course.label: Photography II
ns2:course.description: Uses darkroom process to express content with emphasis on the development of a personal aesthetic. Student must furnish camera. Additional fees may apply. See Class Schedule. Credit is not given for ARTS 265 if credit for ARTD 261 has been earned. Prerequisite: ARTS 264. For Art majors only.
